Gf.bar_b_note: The blue-grey panel fits the UI direction, but it sits over a murky, flat-lit rainy dusk with no light shafts, depth grade or teal/gold accents, so it does not reach Palworld-class UI-over-world finish.

Gl.bar_b_note: The spotted lizard is readable, but it floats on top of the water in the swimming frame and its tail goes rigid in faint end, so it is short of Palworld creature finish.

Ui.bar_b_note: The glossy blue-violet salamander has a clean colour identity, but it is barely taller than the trainer and its plastic-smooth surface lacks the naturalistic scale detail of the style bar.

Uz.bar_b_note: The wolf silhouette and its scale are good, but the dark body sinks into the dark stage with no rim light, and the fur is far less rich than Tanglevolt on the style bar.

Ew.bar_b_note: The Meadows sky and grass carry some warmth, but a lone flat wall panel next to a pale low-poly rock, under flat light with no atmospheric depth, does not read as Palworld base-building finish.

Wx.bar_b_note: The crest is amber, but the rust-brown rigid tail in faint end and the busy giraffe-spot hide that hides the face keep it below the style bar.

Bm.bar_b_note: The yellow-black camouflage blotches break up the silhouette and hide the face and eyes, so it reads as a noisy texture, not an appealing creature.

Od.bar_b_note: B's shaggy white-blue fur approaches the style bar and the creature is clearly taller than the trainer, but A's smooth gradient fur and broken black-block faint end, and the flat stage light on both, fall short.

Ru.bar_b_note: The appealing elder face, readable eyes and a green-brown palette that fits the Meadows key art carry it, though it is more cartoon than the naturalistic creature style.

Oy.bar_b_note: The blue spotted water dragon has a strong silhouette and identity, but the rust-orange crest, the rigid rod tail in faint end and no visible rider in the ridden frame sink it.

Dc.bar_b_note: The blue spotted water dragon has an appealing silhouette and identity, but the rust-orange crest and the stiff stretched tail in faint end keep it short of Palworld finish.

top_changes.change: Move every rust/brown-red crest, frill and fin (Gl/Wx/Oy/Dc) to clear gold, cream or teal, and fix the rigid stretched-rod tail in faint end, so no friendly creature carries enemy-faction red.

Raise creature surfaces to the owner style bar: real fur, scale and plate detail with rim light, tame Bm's camo pattern and Gl/Wx's spot noise so faces and eyes read, and make sure every creature stands taller than the 1.80 m trainer (Ui, Bm, Gl).

Ship side A's direction for the wall (thick timber frame, cap, separate stone footing, warm non-blown infill) and the craft panel (large type, untruncated recipe lines, controller glyph hints in teal), dropping side B's thin pale panel and tiny truncated text.
